item.jaymospowers.sickle_sword.hint: A hooked blade of the sands' old people. Its hook drags a raised shield down.
item.jaymospowers.legion_sword.hint: The plains' old legions stabbed with it from behind the tall shield.
item.jaymospowers.tall_shield.hint: A tall curved board: slow to bring up, and it covers you well.
item.jaymospowers.leaf_spear.hint: A leaf-bladed spear for one hand, carried with the round shield.
item.jaymospowers.old_round_shield.hint: A bronze-faced round shield, quick to raise.
item.jaymospowers.broad_sabre.hint: The walled court's broad curved blade, heavy at the tip.
item.jaymospowers.bearded_axe.hint: The north's old axe. Its long beard hooks a shield aside.
